description: This file defines an Android Activity named NoteDetailActivity that displays the details of a specific note retrieved by its ID. It sets up UI components, handles user interactions, and fetches note data through a notes repository.

classes.name: NoteDetailActivity
classes.description: An Android activity displaying detailed view of a note, including title and content, based on a note ID passed via intent.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, and populates note details based on the note ID provided.
